headline: Harborside United stretch clear at the summit
dek: Harborside United lead the way on 44 points, but Riverside City and Westmoreland Athletic are refusing to let the title race settle.
author: Priya Nair
body: With the business end of the season in view, Harborside United hold a slender advantage at the top of the Atlantic Coast Premier League.
Behind them, Riverside City and Westmoreland Athletic are keeping the pressure on.

headline: Noah Falcone leads the Golden Boot race
dek: Noah Falcone of Bayview United tops the scoring charts with 8 goals this season.
author: Matt Crain
body: Noah Falcone has been the league's standout finisher, with 8 goals leaving the striker clear at the top of the charts.

author: Tom Beckett
